title: Working on the trailer for my retro horror game
author: RedTowerStudio
selftext:
I spent a few days working to flesh out some content and reshoot the trailer for Cults, Monsters, And Beer. It's a fps survival horror game set in Bass Lake California. You take the role of Ben Holloway, a detective spending his savings drinking his life away at his lakeside cabin. You have to fight, run, and hide to survive a night filled with monsters, cultists, and worse. 

But anyway, so I threw this trailer together just by recording a playthrough of my own. After that I established a timeline and a set of beats I wanted to trailer to hit. I had Claude film a few scenes on its own and figure out some music that would work with the sequences I wanted. I based the music on outlast, and used gemini to analyze the music to feed into claude. Idk why but that seems to work better then just using claude some of the times. There wasn't much more in terms of the video, and my last post I think covered what I am doing to really make the game. I am willing to awnser questions if people have them though. 

Demo is almost ready, still polishing some stuff up and finding bugs here and there as I have agents run around doing playthroughs of the game. Having real players would be awesome, but it's hard to find people to playtest.
